title: Becky G to Join Karol G for Multiple Dates of Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour
summary: Venezuelan star Elena Rose and Colombian artist Greeicy will also appear as a special guests on select dates.
contentText:
Becky G and Karol G unite once again. The Mexican-American artist is joining 10 dates of the Colombian superstar’s previously announced Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour, adding even more buzz to one of the year’s biggest stadium runs. The Tuesday (July 14) announcement comes after Becky surprised fans by appearing with Karol during both weekends of Coachella 2026.

Venezuelan star Elena Rose and Colombian artist Greeicy will also be joining the action on select dates. Becky’s guest run will kick off July 29 in Toronto at Rogers Stadium, make stops in major cities including Los Angeles, San Francisco and Seattle, and wraps Sept. 18 at MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, N.J. Elena’s 10-date run begins in Chicago on July 24, with stops in Las Vegas, Boston and Miami before wrapping up in Dallas on Oct. 14. Greeicy, meanwhile, will hop on the Tropitour for three dates: L.A. (Aug. 16), Houston (Sept. 27) and Miami (Oct. 3).

The timing for Becky G feels fitting, as she’s gearing up for the release of her forthcoming album,  Baraja Bendita , due Aug. 14. She’s already introduced the project with “Marathon,” “Epa” and “Patrona,” a run of singles that has framed this chapter as one rooted in confidence, creative freedom and evolution. In her  Billboard  cover story earlier this year, Becky hinted at exactly that kind of expansive mindset, saying, “These days, people want you to stay in just one place. It’s easy to think in black and white, but I always say life is in color — I love coloring outside of the lines.”

It also helps that the pairing of Becky G and Karol G already comes with built-in history: They already have fan-favorite reggaetón-pop smash  “MAMIII” (2022). The hit single reached No. 1 on the Hot Latin Songs, peaked at No. 4 on the Billboard Global 200 and reached a high of No. 15 on the all-genre Billboard Hot 100 . The song also hit No.1 on Latin Airplay and Latin Rhythm Airplay charts.

Below, find and Becky G, Elena Rose and Greeicy’s dates on Karol G’s Viajando Por El Mundo Tropitour. For tickets and additional tour info, visit Karol G’s website .
